# Fixtures

All data in this directory is **synthetic**. Names (e.g. "Example Widgets Pty Ltd"), ids (prefixed `FAKE-` or `disp-`), phones (`+61 400 000 0xx`) and emails (`example.com`) are invented. Shapes and field names match the real connector responses; values do not. Disposition ids are placeholders: real code resolves dispositions by name via `listCallDispositions`.

Never paste real CRM, Nooks, Gmail or ZoomInfo data into this directory.
